summary: Practise NGO team decisions, delegation, conflict handling and accountability. Explore the five-day leadership development course.
lede: Leadership development for NGO team leads and programme managers builds practical ways to make decisions, delegate work and sustain accountability across teams. You’ll frame adaptive challenges, map decision rights with a RACI matrix and prepare constructive conflict conversations, using staff feedback and action planning to strengthen team routines. Adaptive Leadership and the Core Humanitarian Standard provide reference points, while safeguarding responsibilities receive overview-level treatment.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals who lead people, coordinate programme work or influence staff accountability, whether they manage a permanent team or lead across functions.
audience: Monitoring and Evaluation Managers using staff feedback
prerequisites: Prior experience leading or coordinating NGO work is useful. No coding or specialist software is required; bring a laptop if you plan to use a spreadsheet for action tracking.
